cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing Intern (FMCG) position at Henkel. As a junior digital marketer with a strong analytical foundation and a passion for consumer goods, I am drawn to Henkel's commitment to innovation and sustainability. I am confident that my skills in data analysis, content creation, and cross-functional collaboration make me a strong fit for this role.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed a robust skill set in market analysis and performance tracking. I regularly analyze market data, monitor competitors, and evaluate brand performance to inform SEO and content strategies. This experience has honed my ability to work with facts and figures, and I am comfortable using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to derive actionable insights. I am also proficient in MS Office, which I use daily for reporting and presentations.

I thrive in fast-paced, international environments. At Episto, I collaborate with clients across different time zones and manage multiple projects simultaneously, demonstrating my multitasking and flexibility. My background in front-end development and website management has also taught me to maintain strong relationships with internal teams and external partners, ensuring seamless project execution.

I am particularly drawn to Henkel's dynamic professional haircare industry and the opportunity to work closely with a Brand Manager. I am eager to contribute to product launches and PR/media activities, leveraging my content creation skills and attention to detail. I am available for a 6-month internship starting in June or July 2026 and am fluent in English, with a B1 level in Dutch.

Thank you for considering my application. I am enthusiastic about the possibility of bringing my unique perspective to Henkel and contributing to your team's success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
